mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_email_verification(email) VALUES (#{email}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE email = #{email}
mapper.select: SELECT email, code_hash, expires_at, consumed_at, sent_at, window_started_at, send_count, failed_attempts FROM sr_email_verification WHERE email = #{email} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_email_verification SET code_hash = #{codeHash}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, consumed_at = NULL, sent_at = #{sentAt}, window_started_at = #{windowStartedAt}, send_count = #{sendCount}, failed_attempts = 0 WHERE email = #{email}
UPDATE sr_email_verification SET failed_attempts = failed_attempts + 1 WHERE email = #{email}
UPDATE sr_email_verification SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE email = #{email} AND code_hash = #{codeHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND failed_attempts < 5
